title: Add GDPR cookie consent banner with granular controls
acceptance_criteria: Cookie consent banner appears on first visit with 'Accept All', 'Reject All', and 'Customize' options
Customize panel allows granular toggles: Necessary, Analytics, Marketing (ads)
Consent preference stored in localStorage and sent to server for logging in ad_clicks table
GDPR-compliant: no non-necessary cookies set before consent
Banner respects Do Not Track (DNT) browser setting
Consent banner is accessible (keyboard navigable, screen-reader friendly)
Mobile-responsive banner with smooth slide-up animation
